history.notes: ADR-0026/0027. Identity part is already in the tree (State::lead, StatusReport.lead, status `lead`). Log persistence: like lease renewals, a new row does not make State::is_dirty() true (no tool call waits on it); it rides the next persister tick (1 s) or any other write. Outcomes rewrite the file (rare). Escalation routing (c9af0bb7) will add: LeadEvent::EscalationRaised rows, a Route enum {Records, Lead, Human, LogOnly}, and a HumanQueue (items ranked by agents blocked, then wait) owned by LeadPolicy and exposed on /api/lead; not implemented in this run. Budget: Assist::ask takes the site's budget and counts an expiry as a failure (cf60a160).
